title: QRY: pagination cursor rejected on second page for default no-sort case
symptom: The cursor returned from the first page is rejected with HTTP 400 when submitted in the second page request.
root_cause: Sort-fingerprint in the cursor does not round-trip for the default no-sort case (empty sort spec).
acceptance_criteria: A cursor issued for the default (no-sort) case is accepted by the next page request
diagnosis: CONFIRMED (Category A). Cursor wire format QE:<ts>:<fingerprint>:<vals> uses colon as field separator. buildFingerprint in cursor.zig produces values containing colons e.g. record_id:asc. decodeCursor uses std.mem.indexOf(u8, rest_after_ts, colon) which finds the FIRST colon in rest_after_ts — that colon is inside the fingerprint string itself not after it. For no-sort case: fingerprint=record_id:asc, cursor raw=QE:<ts>:record_id:asc:<val>, parser extracts fp_raw=record_id, expected fingerprint.value=record_id:asc -> mismatch -> CursorSortMismatch -> HTTP 400. Fix: change buildFingerprint to use = between name and dir so fingerprint contains no colon.
